nodes.question: How can innovative transportation technologies such as electric and autonomous vehicles contribute to sustainability?
nodes.answer: Innovative transportation technologies such as electric and autonomous vehicles can contribute to sustainability by reducing emissions, improving fuel efficiency, promoting shared mobility services, and facilitating the integration of renewable energy sources into transportation systems.
